caption: The drawing depicts a human-powered tricycle with two large, thin-rimmed spoked wheels in the rear and a smaller, thin-rimmed spoked wheel at the front. The frame is composed of slender, metal tubing and connects all three wheels, with the two large rear wheels mounted on either side and parallel to each other, and the single smaller wheel at the front supported by a fork. The tricycle is equipped with a chain drive mechanism leading to the rear wheels, and pedals are attached to a crank at the center of the frame. A brown saddle-style seat is mounted above the frame and between the rear wheels, along with a metal backrest. Steering is achieved with handlebars connected to the front wheel fork. The color scheme is primarily muted tones, with metallic grays for the frame and wheels, and a brass or bronze color for the seat. The background is an off-white color, and in the lower right corner, the name "HARRY G. ABERDEEN" is written, while in the lower left, the scale is indicated as "SCALE 1" TO 7"."
title: Tricycle
